title: Vietnamese-Style Stir Fry
description: A vegan stir fry recipe inspired by Vietnamese flavors, made with a variety of vegetables and served over rice.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained, and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the wok and set aside.
Add another tablespoon of oil to the wok, then add the broccoli, bell peppers, and onion.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables start to soften, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the ginger and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Return the tofu to the wok and stir in the soy sauce.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the tofu is coated in the sauce and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stir fry over cooked rice.
Garnish with chopped herbs, if desired.
